quantize_numpy_array: quantize a numpy array to discrete levels between a min and max value
dequantize_numpy_array: dequantize a discrete numpy array back to continuous float values
quantize_with_custom_dtype: quantize a numpy array using a custom dtype like int32 or uint8
dequantize_with_custom_dtype: dequantize an array back to a custom dtype like float32 or float64
roundtrip_quantize_dequantize: quantize then dequantize a numpy array to verify roundtrip accuracy
